stage_definitions.catalog_rows: rows in the cached Gaia DR3 CSV for the preset (G<15 Barnard/RW Aur, G<17 others; r=0.075 deg)
stage_definitions.two_parameter: no proper motion in Gaia; skipped (not assumed static)
stage_definitions.near_target: propagated position within 40 arcsec of the catalog-predicted target (target and its halo)
stage_definitions.outside_footprint: projects outside the native cutout through the header WCS
stage_definitions.attempted: inside footprint and not near target, minus edge (measurement window fits)
stage_definitions.edge: measurement window (7x7 native px around the rounded position) leaves the cutout
stage_definitions.nonfinite: measurement window contains a non-finite pixel
stage_definitions.low_snr: peak - local median < 15 x MAD (eligibility; applied BEFORE association)
stage_definitions.snr_eligible: attempted measurements that pass the SNR cut
stage_definitions.association: SNR-eligible but native centroid >= 1 native px from Gaia (dropped by the legacy rule)
stage_definitions.png_window: native match, but the PNG 33x33 box has transparent pixels or leaves the grid
stage_definitions.retained: used in the published PNG residual headline

eligibility_note: The SNR cut is evaluated in a window centred on the Gaia-predicted position (forced photometry). It precedes the 1 px association cut, but it is not independent of the registration: if the header were off by >~3 native px the star would leave the window and fail the SNR cut, so it would vanish silently instead of being counted as a mismatch. blind_matching.json uses a WCS-free eligibility to close this gap.
